render.stationsManifestPrelude: # samcoupe (slot 187) — SAM Coupé, host-native MAME samcoupe, boot menu of period software; samcoupe wave 2026-09-08.

museum.arch: Zilog Z80B, 6 MHz, 512 KB (ASIC video, 256 colours)
museum.blurb: The Spectrum's Welsh successor: a 6 MHz Z80B with 512 KB, a 128-colour palette and a floppy drive in the case. Boots SAMDOS into a one-key menu — Manic Miner, Mr. Pac, Splat!, The Secretary word processor, and SAM BASIC to type into.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's samcoupe driver runs on the host (drawshm frames, ctlsock keys, FIFO audio), ROM v3.1, no QEMU and no guest OS. -flop1 is hive.mgt, an 800K SAMDOS 2.0 disk composed on the host by scripts/build-guests/tiles/samcoupe.sh; SAMDOS auto-runs the first file whose name starts with 'auto', which is the SAM BASIC menu. Keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none), like apple2e. Titles load from floppy in ~20-25 s. See docs/lab/SAMCOUPE-WAVE.md.

reset.mouse: N/A — keyboard-only exhibit (pointer transport none); see the wave brief's OPEN items
reset.keyboard: PARTIALLY VERIFIED at the fleet 40/40 ms pacing on the framebuffer (2026-09-08): `1` (Manic Miner) reaches the title screen with no dropped/duplicated characters. `B` (SAM BASIC) is OPEN — on the real ctlsock KEY path the guest lands in the BASIC program-EDIT view instead of a clean `0 OK` prompt; a follow-up stream needs to find the key that clears it. `2`/`3`/`4` untested (same INKEY$ mechanism as the proven `1`, low risk).
reset.fixture: SAM Coupé "KERNEL HIVE - SAM COUPE" boot menu (5 entries), golden savestate baked at the menu so a visitor never sees the MGT copyright banner or the BOOT keystroke. MEASURED 2026-09-08: cold boot→menu 9.0 s, SAVEST 13 ms/11871 bytes, relaunch restore 4.7 s and pixel-identical (PIL diff bbox None) to the baked frame.
